name: Adaptive Utility
body:
Prerequisite(s): Utility wild talent class feature

Benefit: You treat the effective spell level of all utility wild talents as 1/2 your kineticist level for determining their DCs.

Normal: Utility wild talents have their effective spell level treated as their level for determining their DCs.

Special: Legendary kineticists who take this feat instead increase the DCs of their utility wild talents by 1.
